context: Two cafe friends discuss judging people by appearance
purpose: Teach: 外見/プライド/資質/モラル/狩り/シンボル/青空/マスク

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ、さっきのお客さん、マスク姿だったから怖そうに見えたけど、話したらすごく優しい人だったよ。
lines.en: Hey, that customer earlier looked scary because of the mask, but when I talked to him he was really kind.
lines.style: Friendly, observational, slightly surprised by the contrast.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わかる。外見だけで判断するのって、本当によくないよね。
lines.en: I get it. Judging people purely on appearance is really not okay, is it.
lines.style: Soft, reflective, gentle agreement with a small sigh.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。その人の資質って、ちゃんと話してみないとわからないものだしね。
lines.en: Yeah. You really can't tell what someone is made of until you actually talk with them.
lines.style: Calm, thoughtful, speaking from experience behind the counter.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ほんとだよ。私の元彼なんて、見た目は完璧だったのに、プライドが高くて全然優しくなかったの。
lines.en: Seriously. My ex looked perfect on the outside, but he had so much pride and wasn't kind at all.
lines.style: Slightly bitter but laughing it off, romantic disappointment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うわぁ、それは辛いね。やっぱり顔より、モラルがちゃんとしてる人がいいよ。
lines.en: Ouch, that's rough. As I thought, someone with solid morals is better than just a nice face.
lines.style: Sympathetic, leaning in, validating her friend's feelings warmly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ね。次は、青空の下で一緒に散歩できるくらい穏やかな人がいいな。
lines.en: Right. Next time I want someone calm enough that we can just walk together under a blue sky.
lines.style: Dreamy, romantic, looking out the window wistfully.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね。恋愛って狩りみたいに焦ると、相手のこと全然見えなくなっちゃうもんね。
lines.en: Nice. When dating turns into a hunt and you get impatient, you stop seeing the other person at all.
lines.style: Witty, warm, smiling while wiping the counter casually.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。ハートマークみたいな分かりやすいシンボルに惑わされないで、ちゃんと中身を見たいな。
lines.en: Yeah. I don't want to be fooled by obvious symbols like heart marks, I want to really see what's inside.
lines.style: Determined, hopeful, romantic but newly grounded and self-aware.
